ISO 9001:2015 Certification Successfully Renewed for 2025–2026

Modina Rim & Parts Ltd. has completed its annual ISO 9001:2015 surveillance audit with zero non-conformances, reaffirming our commitment to world-class quality management.

3 MIN READ

New CNG Rim Variant Released for Commercial Fleet Operators

Following market demand from commercial operators, Modina has introduced a reinforced CNG rim variant engineered for higher load ratings and extended service life.

4 MIN READ

Modina Participates in Dhaka International Trade Expo 2026

Our team showcased the full 2026 product range at the Dhaka International Trade Expo, connecting with over 200 distributors and manufacturers from across South Asia.

5 MIN READ

INDUSTRY

Bangladesh Automotive Parts Sector Grows 18% in FY2025

The Bangladesh automotive components manufacturing sector recorded strong growth in fiscal year 2025, driven by rising domestic demand and increased export volumes to neighboring markets.

Modina Expands Distribution Network to Chittagong and Sylhet

To better serve our regional clients, Modina has established two new distribution centers in Chittagong and Sylhet, reducing delivery times by up to 40% for customers in those regions.

New Motorcycle Handlebar Range Passes Stress Testing at 200% Load

Our latest motorcycle handlebar range has completed rigorous stress testing at 200% of rated load capacity, setting a new benchmark for durability in the Bangladeshi market.

South Asian Auto Parts Summit — Modina Keynote Speaker

Rising Steel Costs and the Case for Domestic Manufacturing

COMPANY NEWS

MARCH 2026

ISO 9001:2015 Certification Successfully Renewed for 2025–2026

Modina Rim & Parts Ltd. has completed its annual ISO 9001:2015 surveillance audit with zero non-conformances, reaffirming our commitment to world-class quality management.

3 MIN READ

PRODUCT UPDATES

FEBRUARY 2026

New CNG Rim Variant Released for Commercial Fleet Operators

Following market demand from commercial operators, Modina has introduced a reinforced CNG rim variant engineered for higher load ratings and extended service life.

4 MIN READ

EVENTS

JANUARY 2026

Modina Participates in Dhaka International Trade Expo 2026

Our team showcased the full 2026 product range at the Dhaka International Trade Expo, connecting with over 200 distributors and manufacturers from across South Asia.

5 MIN READ

INDUSTRY

DECEMBER 2025

Bangladesh Automotive Parts Sector Grows 18% in FY2025

The Bangladesh automotive components manufacturing sector recorded strong growth in fiscal year 2025, driven by rising domestic demand and increased export volumes to neighboring markets.

6 MIN READ

COMPANY NEWS

NOVEMBER 2025

Modina Expands Distribution Network to Chittagong and Sylhet

To better serve our regional clients, Modina has established two new distribution centers in Chittagong and Sylhet, reducing delivery times by up to 40% for customers in those regions.

3 MIN READ

PRODUCT UPDATES

OCTOBER 2025

New Motorcycle Handlebar Range Passes Stress Testing at 200% Load

Our latest motorcycle handlebar range has completed rigorous stress testing at 200% of rated load capacity, setting a new benchmark for durability in the Bangladeshi market.

4 MIN READ

EVENTS

SEPTEMBER 2025

South Asian Auto Parts Summit — Modina Keynote Speaker

Modina Managing Director Mohammed Rafiqul Islam delivered the keynote address at the South Asian Auto Parts Summit in Colombo, speaking on precision manufacturing and regional supply chains.

5 MIN READ

INDUSTRY

AUGUST 2025

Rising Steel Costs and the Case for Domestic Manufacturing

As global steel prices continue to fluctuate, Bangladeshi manufacturers who have invested in domestic supply chains are proving more resilient than those dependent on imports.

7 MIN READ

COMPANY NEWS

MARCH 2026

ISO 9001:2015 Certification Successfully Renewed for 2025–2026

Modina Rim & Parts Ltd. has completed its annual ISO 9001:2015 surveillance audit with zero non-conformances, reaffirming our commitment to world-class quality management.

3 MIN READ

PRODUCT UPDATES

FEBRUARY 2026

New CNG Rim Variant Released for Commercial Fleet Operators

Following market demand from commercial operators, Modina has introduced a reinforced CNG rim variant engineered for higher load ratings and extended service life.

4 MIN READ

EVENTS

JANUARY 2026

Modina Participates in Dhaka International Trade Expo 2026

Our team showcased the full 2026 product range at the Dhaka International Trade Expo, connecting with over 200 distributors and manufacturers from across South Asia.

5 MIN READ

INDUSTRY

DECEMBER 2025

Bangladesh Automotive Parts Sector Grows 18% in FY2025

The Bangladesh automotive components manufacturing sector recorded strong growth in fiscal year 2025, driven by rising domestic demand and increased export volumes to neighboring markets.

6 MIN READ

COMPANY NEWS

NOVEMBER 2025

Modina Expands Distribution Network to Chittagong and Sylhet

To better serve our regional clients, Modina has established two new distribution centers in Chittagong and Sylhet, reducing delivery times by up to 40% for customers in those regions.

3 MIN READ

PRODUCT UPDATES

OCTOBER 2025

New Motorcycle Handlebar Range Passes Stress Testing at 200% Load

Our latest motorcycle handlebar range has completed rigorous stress testing at 200% of rated load capacity, setting a new benchmark for durability in the Bangladeshi market.

4 MIN READ

EVENTS

SEPTEMBER 2025

South Asian Auto Parts Summit — Modina Keynote Speaker

Modina Managing Director Mohammed Rafiqul Islam delivered the keynote address at the South Asian Auto Parts Summit in Colombo, speaking on precision manufacturing and regional supply chains.

5 MIN READ

INDUSTRY

AUGUST 2025

Rising Steel Costs and the Case for Domestic Manufacturing

As global steel prices continue to fluctuate, Bangladeshi manufacturers who have invested in domestic supply chains are proving more resilient than those dependent on imports.

7 MIN READ

description: Modina Rim & Parts Ltd. is a leading automotive rim and parts manufacturer in Bangladesh. ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 14001 certified. 21+ products, 15+ years of precision engineering excellence.

Across the automotive supply chain, tolerance specifications are often treated as an afterthought. At Modina, we argue that ±0.01mm is not a number on a datasheet — it is the difference between a part that lasts and a part that fails.
